'''Spidervine tea''' was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] that was among the [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverages]] available at the [[Farrimmer Cafe]] [[Cantina/Legends|eatery]] aboard the [[Mynock 7 Space Station]]<ref name="Journal11" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Mynock 7 Station system/Legends|star system]] containing the [[Mynock 7 Space Station]]</ref> at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Journal11" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spidervine tea was mentioned in "[[The Farrimmer Cafe]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] source article authored by [[Jean Rabe]] and [[J. Allan Fawcett]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[November]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal11" />
